name: Relevance
description: The degree to which the response is directly related to the user's question or the given context. It measures how well the response addresses the user's query or task.

name: Coherence
description: The logical consistency and smoothness of the response. It measures how well the response follows a logical or semantic structure, and how well the ideas and sentences are connected.

name: Accuracy
description: The correctness of the information or instructions provided in the response. It measures how well the response aligns with established facts, theories, and best practices in the relevant domain.

name: Completeness
description: The extent to which the response covers all the necessary aspects of the user's question or task. It measures how well the response addresses all the important details and subtopics.

name: Conciseness
description: The degree to which the response is free of redundancy and unnecessary information. It measures how succinctly the response conveys the required information.

name: Clarity
description: The ease with which the response can be understood. It measures how effectively the response communicates its intended meaning, using clear, unambiguous language.
